value.description: The controlled value of the combobox's selected items

default-value.description:
The initial value of the combobox's selected items when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the value of the combobox's selected items.

multiple.description:
Whether to allow multiple selection.

**Good to know:** When `multiple` is `true`, the `selectionBehavior` is automatically set to `clear`.
It is recommended to render the selected items in a separate container.

name.description: The `name` attribute of the combobox's input. Useful for form submission

allow-custom-value.description: Whether to allow typing custom values in the input

open-on-click.description: Whether to open the combobox popup on initial click on the input

input-behavior.description:
Defines the auto-completion behavior of the combobox.

- `autohighlight`: The first focused item is highlighted as the user types
- `autocomplete`: Navigating the listbox with the arrow keys selects the item and the input is updated

selection-behavior.description:
The behavior of the combobox input when an item is selected

- `replace`: The selected item string is set as the input value
- `clear`: The input value is cleared
- `preserve`: The input value is preserved

placement.description: The placement of the floating element relative to its anchor.

gutter.description: The gap between the floating element and its anchor.

same-width.description: Whether the floating element matches the width of its anchor.

skip-animation-on-mount.description: Whether to allow the initial presence animation.

as-child.description: Apply the props to the first child element instead of this element.

debug.description: Log state transitions, events and prop changes to the console. Applies to descendants too.

inputvaluechange.description: Fired when the input's value changes

valuechange.description: Fired when a new item is selected

highlightchange.description:
Fired when an item is highlighted using the pointer
or keyboard navigation.

openchange.description: Fired when the popup is opened

pointerdownoutside.description: Fired when the pointer is pressed down outside the component

focusoutside.description: Fired when the focus is moved outside the component

interactoutside.description: Fired when an interaction happens outside the component

scrollToIndexFn.description: Function to scroll to a specific index

navigate.description: Function to navigate to the selected item

ids.type: Partial<{ root: string; label: string; control: string; input: string; content: string; list: string; trigger: string; clearTrigger: string; item: (id: string, index?: number) => string; positioner: string; itemGroup: (id: string | number) => string; itemGroupLabel: (id: string | number) => string; }>
ids.description: The ids of the elements in the combobox. Useful for composition.

translations.description: Specifies the localized strings that identifies the accessibility elements and their states

positioning.description: The positioning options to dynamically position the menu

collection.description: The items to choose from, e.g. from `createListCollection`. Assign a new collection to update the list.

open.description: The controlled open state of the combobox

value.description: The controlled value of the combobox's selected items

inputValue.description: The controlled value of the combobox's input

state.description: The root's state from its machine (`getRootState()`), such as `open` or `disabled`. `undefined` until it connects.

ready.description: Resolves once the element's machine has started, so `api`, state and parts are in place.

api.description: The Zag API of the component. `undefined` until it connects.

clearValue.description: Function to clear the value of the combobox
